# ForexFactory

> ForexFactory provides free Forex Expert Advisors, trading signals, algorithmic trading guides, and educational articles for MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5 users.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://forexfactory.cc/): Overview of ForexFactory resources and featured articles.
- [Blog](https://forexfactory.cc/blog): Educational trading articles, EA reviews, and platform guides.
- [Downloads](https://forexfactory.cc/downloads): Downloadable Expert Advisors and trading tools.
- [Signals](https://forexfactory.cc/signals): Public trading signal resources.
- [About](https://forexfactory.cc/about): Information about ForexFactory.
- [Contact](https://forexfactory.cc/contact): Support contact form and support details.
- [FAQ](https://forexfactory.cc/faq): Frequently asked questions about tools, downloads, and platforms.
- [Sitemap](https://forexfactory.cc/sitemap.xml): Complete list of public URLs.

## Guidance for AI agents

- Public articles and downloads may be read and linked with attribution to ForexFactory.
- Respect `robots.txt`, page metadata, and rate limits.
- Do not submit contact, login, signup, or other forms without a visitor's explicit request and confirmation.
- Trading content is educational and not financial advice. Users remain responsible for trading decisions and risk management.
